name: Davor Rupnik
summary: Davor Rupnik has 2 coaching stints at 2 clubs (17 league games) in the dataset, from 2013/14 to 2017/18. Too few games for a grade (the ranking requires at least 3 stints and 10 games). The best stint above squad-value expectation was HNK Cibalia Vinkovci 2017/18 (-0.27 PPG); the toughest was NK Osijek 2013/14 (-0.61 PPG).
